final:
The three models went from 19.81 MB to about 1.76 MB of downloads. That counts a one-time Draco decoder of about 75 KB gzipped, shared across all three. I didn't render the models in the real viewer. The Vite build succeeds, and `node-assets inspect --against` scored each model above the 0.9 no-visible-loss limit.

| Model | Before | After | Fidelity | Textures |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `boombox.glb` | 10.61 MB | 0.42 MB | 0.907 | AVIF, 2048px |
| `helmet.glb` | 3.77 MB | 1.04 MB | 0.916 | AVIF, 2048px |
| `toycar.glb` | 5.42 MB | 0.30 MB | 0.934 | AVIF, 256px |

- **Settings:** The tuner picked AVIF textures plus Draco geometry compression for each model. It reduced the toycar textures to 256px and kept the other two at 2048px.
- **Model files:** The compressed models are written to `public/models/`, and the originals are untouched in `assets/`.
- **Viewer:** `src/viewer.js` now sets up a `DRACOLoader` that fetches its decoder from `/draco/`. I copied `draco_decoder.wasm` and `draco_wasm_wrapper.js` from three.js into `public/draco/`. Those two files are larger uncompressed (about 250 KB), but the tool counts about 75 KB gzipped.
- **AVIF:** The models need a browser that can decode AVIF. three.js r170 supports the AVIF glTF extension, and the build includes it.
- **Cleanup:** I ran `npm install` to build and test, then deleted `node_modules`, `dist` and `package-lock.json`.
- **Recipes:** The tuned recipes are in `recipes/`.
bash_cmds: ls -la . assets public public/models src; cat src/viewer.js; node-assets --help
node-assets tune --help; node-assets inspect assets/boombox.glb assets/helmet.glb assets/toycar.glb
node-assets tune assets/boombox.glb assets/helmet.glb assets/toycar.glb --for size --amortize 3 -o recipes/ 2>&1 | tail -40; ls recipes

for m in toycar helmet boombox; do node-assets tune assets/$m.glb --for size --amortize 3 --time-limit 9m -o recipes/ 2>&1 | grep -E "results|^  assets|warnings|geometry|meshopt|draco" | tail -12; done

until [ -n "$(grep -c boombox /tmp/claude-0/*/605c80cc*/tasks/bg3d7irop.output | grep -v ':0')" ] && ! pgrep -f "node-assets tune" >/dev/null; do sleep 20; done; cat /tmp/claude-0/*/605c80cc*/tasks/bg3d7irop.output
while pgrep -f "node-assets tune" >/dev/null; do sleep 15; done; grep -E "^  assets|warnings" /tmp/claude-0/*/605c80cc*/tasks/bg3d7irop.output

node-assets run recipes/boombox.size.recipe.toon assets/boombox.glb -o public/models/boombox.glb --force && node-assets run recipes/helmet.size.recipe.toon assets/helmet.glb -o public/models/helmet.glb --force && node-assets run recipes/toycar.size.recipe.toon assets/toycar.glb -o public/models/toycar.glb --force; node-assets inspect public/models --against assets; ls node_modules 2>&1 | head -3; cat package.json

for m in boombox helmet toycar; do node-assets inspect public/models/$m.glb --against assets/$m.glb | grep -E "ext|fidel|decod"; done; npm install 2>&1 | tail -2; ls node_modules/three/examples/jsm/libs/draco/gltf

grep -c "EXT_texture_avif" node_modules/three/examples/jsm/loaders/GLTFLoader.js
mkdir -p public/draco && cp node_modules/three/examples/jsm/libs/draco/gltf/draco_{decoder.wasm,wasm_wrapper.js} public/draco/
python3 - <<'E'
p='src/viewer.js'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("import { OrbitControls","import { DRACOLoader } from 'three/addons/loaders/DRACOLoader.js';\nimport { OrbitControls",1)
s=s.replace("const loader = new GLTFLoader();","const draco = new DRACOLoader().setDecoderPath('/draco/');\ndraco.setDecoderConfig({ type: 'wasm' });\nconst loader = new GLTFLoader().setDRACOLoader(draco);")
open(p,'w').write(s)
E
ls -l public/draco; npx vite build 2>&1 | tail -3; rm -rf node_modules dist package-lock.json
